images.title: The river crossing
images.purpose: Show the boatman, the boat, the lion, the sheep and the grass on the near bank of a river.
images.composition: A river running across the middle of the frame, a near bank at the bottom and a far bank at the top, with the boat and the three things on the near bank.
images.exact_structure: A blue river band (#0072B2) running horizontally across the middle of the frame. Bottom bank in light green with, from left to right: a lion, a sheep, a bundle of grass, each standing apart with a small gap. Beside them at the edge of the water a small wooden boat with a boatman holding an oar. Top bank in light green and empty. A thin arrow in #CC79A7 points from the boat across the river to the top bank. Labels under the near bank items only.

images.takeaway: The boat carries one at a time, and the sheep cannot be left with the lion or with the grass.
